title: Senior Workforce Analyst
description:
This role is built for someone who knows how to run workforce planning as a discipline-not just report on it. We are looking for a seasoned workforce analyst who can build and own the models that drive hiring, coverage, effecti9ve client engagement, and organizational design decisions while staying aligned to real-time executive priorities.

This individual will sit at the center of workforce strategy to translate business demand, pipeline movement, and personnel changes into clear, actionable hiring and resourcing decisions. The proper candidate must be able to operate at executive speed, providing timely updates on hiring progress, pipeline health, and risks tied to attrition or performance.

The right candidate will recognize this is a role for someone who has built workforce models before and knows how to translate their analysis into effective decisions.

Essential Job Responsibilities Include:

•
Strategic Workforce Modeling & Planning

• Build and continuously refine workforce models that align capacity with business demand drivers (sales pipeline, renewals, account segmentation, and account complexity).

• Develop and maintain a group and individual-level capacity model for Strategic Account Executives (SAEs) that accounts for variability in workload, tenure, and performance.

• Create and evolve an account complexity framework (client size, program mix, broker dynamics, service requirements, etc.) and translate that into differentiated capacity assumptions.

• Move beyond “accounts per individual” thinking to a weighted capacity model, where more complex clients appropriately consume more capacity.

• Translate forecasted new business, client changes, and expected retention churn into forward-looking hiring and coverage plans based on true capacity-not averages.

• Develop scenario-based models to guide leadership decisions on headcount, timing of hires, and organizational structure as client base grows.

•
Executive Visibility & Real-Time Updates

• Serve as the single source of truth for workforce planning updates to senior leadership.

• Maintain a real-time view of open roles, candidate pipeline status, and hiring progress.

• Provide frequent, clear updates on:

• Hiring pipeline health and velocity.

• Role prioritization and sequencing.

• At-risk personnel (performance, attrition risk, transitions) and associated backfill/capacity needs.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Your Impact

As a Manager on the Product Integrity team, you'll lead the engineers who prove Axon's hardware is ready for the field. The Manager, Hardware Validation owns the hardware validation plan and team for all Axon products. This role blends people leadership with hands-on technical ownership: coaching a team of validation engineers, setting the technical bar for test rigor, and partnering across Hardware, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, and Program Management teams to ensure products meet functional, environmental, reliability, and safety requirements at every program milestone.

What You'll Do

Location: Onsite at our Phoenix, Deer Valley location

Reports to: Senior Director, Product Integrity

Direct Reports: Hardware Validation Engineers

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of hardware validation engineers, setting technical direction, priorities, and career growth plans.

• Own the validation plan for assigned product programs, from requirements definition through prototype, development, and production release.

• Define and drive execution of test plans covering functional, environmental (thermal, vibration, ingress, drop/shock), EMC/EMI, reliability, and safety compliance testing.

• Partner with Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory teams to identify design risks early and drive root-cause investigations to closure.

• Support test lab infrastructure needs, including equipment, fixtures, automation, and data systems, for assigned product lines.

• Track validation metrics and exit criteria for program gate reviews, and report status and risk to the Sr. Manager, Hardware Validation.

• Support relationships with external test labs and certification bodies (UL, FCC, CE, MIL-STD, IP ratings, and similar) for assigned programs.

• Drive continuous improvement in test coverage, cycle time, and defect escape rates within the team.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in hardware test, validation, or reliability engineering.

• 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineers in a validation, test, or reliability function.

• Hands-on experience with environmental and reliability test methods (e.g., HALT/HASS, vibration, thermal, ingress, drop/shock, EMC).

• Working knowledge of industry and regulatory test standards (MIL-STD, IEC, ISO, ASTM) and EMC/regulatory certification processes.

• Experience with test automation, data acquisition systems, and statistical analysis of test results (e.g., DOE, reliability modeling, Weibull analysis).

• Strong communication skills, with experience presenting test results and technical trade-offs to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience with connected/IoT hardware, wearables, or public safety technology is a plus.

• Six Sigma Green Belt certification a plus.

Travel required:

Up to 15%, for manufacturing and supplier site visits, outside test labs, and program reviews.
